Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.audit

Class KfeNetworkObservationLogEntity

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.audit.KfeNetworkObservationLogEntity
@Entity public class KfeNetworkObservationLogEntity extends Object
Append-only, privacy-safe record of external settlement observations for reconciliation and audit. Indexes support transaction- and network-transaction-centric timelines; this row intentionally stores a transaction reference and chain state without a wallet address, invoice, or user payload.
